verdict.rationale: Consensus documents Deep Search (more comprehensive literature reviews across many studies, "in minutes") and a research agent that chains search tools. Nothing in the evidence shows a job that keeps running unattended in the background or notifies the user when results are ready. Deep Search is an adjacent long-running research feature, not the asked-for unattended-job-plus-notification capability.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready
